intended_object: The last element aₙ of a (nonempty) relation series a₀ -r→ a₁ -r→ … -r→ aₙ (from the docstring and name).
explanation: A RelSeries r with length n is a function Fin (n+1) → α with consecutive entries related by r. Evaluating it at Fin.last n, which is index n, gives aₙ, the last element. A series is never empty, so there is no degenerate case. The definition works for an arbitrary relation r on an arbitrary type α, so it is at its natural generality.
